en.title: Who owes
en.summary: Everyone at this branch with unpaid bills, the most owed first.

sections.heading: The list
sections.body: Each patient with a bill still owing: how many unpaid bills, the date of the oldest, and the total. The name opens their chart; Open bills goes to their Billing tab, where the payment is taken.

sections.heading: Waiting for a manager
sections.body: Bills whose discount is over the clinic's limit, and bills someone has asked to void, wait in Approvals → Discounts and Voids. They take no payment until a manager decides.

am.title: ዕዳ ያለባቸው
am.summary: በዚህ ቅርንጫፍ ያልተከፈለ ሂሳብ ያለበት ሁሉ፣ ብዙ ያለበት መጀመሪያ።

sections.heading: ዝርዝሩ
sections.body: አሁንም የሚከፈል ሂሳብ ያለበት እያንዳንዱ ታካሚ፦ ስንት ያልተከፈሉ ሂሳቦች፣ የቆየው ቀን እና ድምሩ። ስሙ ቻርታቸውን ይከፍታል፤ Open bills ክፍያው ወደሚወሰድበት የክፍያ ትራቸው ይወስዳል።

sections.heading: ሥራ አስኪያጅ የሚጠብቁ
sections.body: ቅናሻቸው ከክሊኒኩ ገደብ በላይ የሆኑ ሂሳቦች እና እንዲሰረዙ የተጠየቁ ሂሳቦች በApprovals → Discounts and Voids ይጠብቃሉ። ሥራ አስኪያጅ እስኪወስን ክፍያ አይቀበሉም።
